verses.pali: Yo ca akappiye kappiyasaññī, yo ca kappiye akappiyasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives what is unallowable as allowable, and one who perceives what is allowable as unallowable.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements grow.”
